scope: Finite conditional grammar audit. It tests a retentional-closure theorem but does not add a persistence law, external time, public record, or physical observer.

conditional_theorem.RC: intrinsic cross-phase relations must be carried by declared ordered overlap
conditional_theorem.component_closure: intrinsic relations of a finite mode do not compare undeclared distinct components
conditional_theorem.structural_identity: isomorphic declared self-presentation structures are one description class
conditional_theorem.conclusion: H_full=(Z2)^4 is lift gauge; one class of 16 lifts

rival_bridge.CPC: within one P/Q flow component, free-bit values c and d have an intrinsic equality/inequality comparator J_s=c xor d
rival_bridge.effect: H_full changes J_s and is not gauge

restricted_conclusion: The exact overlap structure supplies a conditional derivation of full gauge only under RC plus component closure and structural identity. RC is the required new content principle: without it, the within-component relation J_s is an equally coherent candidate observable and full gauge remains unproved. Current AP3P1/AP3J state neither RC nor CPC, so the desired conclusion has not yet been derived.
